summary: The identity and current availability of an IBM program named Ignite Africa remain unconfirmed after checking the former URL and searching official and partner material.

sources.title: Former IBM Ignite Africa URL — retrieval attempt
sources.supports: The URL was inaccessible; no program content was verified from it.

sources.title: Wits University startup bootcamp announcement
sources.supports: A distinct IBM South Africa/Tshimologong startup bootcamp ran in October–November 2018. It does not establish an Ignite Africa successor.

notes: Other Ignite Africa organizations and the historical IBM South Africa bootcamp do not confirm this program.
